Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)
 and nursing_audit_flag = 'Y'
 and nursing_audit_status in ('O', 'N', 'H')
 and not exists
 (select 'x'
 from components c
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)
 and system_label_decision not in ('39', '71')
 and reject_reason_code is null
 );
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('5111');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

 if form_success
 then
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');

 check_package_failure;

 end;
